proposals.name: Custom Mechanical Keyboard Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-savvy professionals and gamers who spend thousands on custom aluminum keyboards, keycap sets, and desk setups. They love highly aesthetic, minimalist, or retro-themed workspaces.
product_angles: Sticker packs of exploded switch anatomy diagrams (Redbubble)
3D-printable custom keycap cases or switch lubing stations (Cults3D)
proposals.best_pipeline_or_new: produce_svg_pack (for vectors) and produce_stl_parametric (for switch stations)
proposals.first_test_product: A minimalist vector deskmat design matching the classic 'GMK Laser' or 'Retro 9009' color schemes for Redbubble.

proposals.name: Solo Board Gamers & Print-and-Play (PnP) Players
proposals.buyer_persona: Board game hobbyists who prefer playing alone or print their own indie games. They highly value organization, modularity, and physical game trackers.
product_angles: 3D printable universal card holders and modular token organizers (Cults3D)
Solo campaign progress journal logs with tactile habit-tracker-style layouts (KDP)
Print-and-Play micro-game components and dice towers (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: A compact, 3D-printable travel card holder and token tray combination that fits inside a standard mint tin.

proposals.name: Speech-Language Pathologists / Orthophonistes
proposals.buyer_persona: Overworked professionals looking for engaging, non-boring materials to use with children or adults in therapy sessions, often buying with their own or company budgets.
product_angles: Phoneme-specific minimalist coloring books for articulation therapy (KDP)
Orthophonie-themed humorous stickers and tote bags for practitioners (Redbubble)
Therapy session tracking notebooks and planners (KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: A French-focused coloring book containing illustrations containing specific target sounds (e.g., 'Le livre de coloriage du son [R]') for young patients.

proposals.name: Retro Handheld Console Modders
proposals.buyer_persona: Owners of retro gaming devices (Miyoo Mini, Anbernic, Steam Deck) who love customizing their devices with aesthetic accessories, custom grips, and nostalgic decals.
product_angles: 3D printable ergonomic snap-on grips for Miyoo Mini / RG35XX (Cults3D)
Nostalgic 90s console aesthetic stickers and shell wrap SVG templates (Redbubble / Cults3D)
Retro gaming pixel-art themed carrying case inserts (Cults3D)
proposals.best_pipeline_or_new: produce_stl_parametric (for physical grips) and produce_svg_pack (for decals)
proposals.first_test_product: A 3D-printable minimalist ergonomic grip/shield combo for the Miyoo Mini Plus.

proposals.name: Urban Sketchers & Plein Air Painters
proposals.buyer_persona: Artists who paint or draw outdoors in cities. They need highly portable, lightweight gear, tiny water containers, and compact watercolor palette solutions.
product_angles: 3D-printable magnetic palette clips that attach directly to sketchbooks (Cults3D)
Pocket-sized color-swatching journals with watercolor paper template pages (KDP)
Urban Sketching challenge prompt books with perspective grids (KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: A 3D-printable micro-watercolor palette (6 wells) with an integrated clip to attach to an A6 sketchbook.

proposals.name: Local Micro-Breweries & Craft Beer Homebrewers
proposals.buyer_persona: Homebrewers and independent micro-breweries who pride themselves on their craft recipes, requiring structured logs and professional-looking taproom accessories.
product_angles: Comprehensive homebrew recipe formulation logbooks with gravity charts (KDP)
Customizable tap handle 3D print designs with chalk-paint inserts (Cults3D)
Humorous organic chemistry/brewing physics posters for taproom decoration (Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: A detailed 'Homebrewer's Brew Day Logbook' containing batch sheets, water chemistry sections, and hop addition trackers.
